title: Show Resume for a paused delegation wait before any result is queued
outcome: An idle parent with an unfinished delegation wait and an empty queue has a visible Resume control after explicit Stop. Resume calls the existing queue route and releases the automatic-resume latch without waiting for a result or starting the children again.
acceptance: A UI behavior test exercises an idle paused delegation wait with an empty queue and verifies that Resume calls the existing session queue action.
The control preserves the existing recovery behavior for an actionable queued prompt, capacity wait and test-run wait.
